name: Crest
tagline: New full-screen layouts with a large cover or the artist's photo, and a lighter Wavee: far less GPU and memory, especially when paused or minimized.

highlights.title: Full screen, your way
highlights.body: The full-screen options now have two tabs. Visualizer shows every visualizer at a glance. Layout decides where the cover and lyrics sit on top of it: a large cover beside the lyrics, the cover centered in a ring, or the artist's photo filling the screen with a slow pan, with the lyrics over it if you like. Your visualizer keeps running behind the cover layouts.

highlights.title: Lighter on your PC
highlights.body: Wavee redraws only what changed, so lyrics, song changes and scrolling use far less of the GPU. Paused, the full screen stops animating instead of drawing over a hundred frames a second. Minimized or in the tray, Wavee gives its drawing memory back, and the AI lyrics models load only when a song needs them.

highlights.title: Headphones, local files and dialogs
highlights.body: Connecting Bluetooth headphones no longer leaves playback silent, and pressing Play retries an output that refused to start. Local music videos play their sound, and a local file's path is never sent to Spotify. File and folder dialogs, Change cover and the taskbar jump list no longer freeze the window.
